ledger.x: 1924, 27 October: the Uzbek SSR is created at the national delimitation of Central Asia; infobox "Republic proclaimed: 5 December 1924".

1924, October: the Turkestan ASSR, the Bukharan People's Soviet Republic and the Khorezm People's Soviet Republic "were abolished" and their lands divided; the Turkestan lands of the Uzbek SSR are drawn as Tashkent, Samarkand, Fergana and Khujand (the page lists no districts).
1924, October: West Bukhara passes to the Uzbek SSR (the page names the Bukharan republic as abolished; the line is the Bukharan dossier's).
1924, October: Khorezm passes to the Uzbek SSR (the page names the Khorezm republic as abolished; the line is the Khorezm dossier's).
1924, 14 October: the Tajik ASSR "had been created on 14 October 1924 as a part of the predominantly Turkic Uzbek SSR".

1929, 15 October: "Tajik Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic [...] and a region around Khujand split off and become the Tajik Soviet Socialist Republic" (the Tajik page dates the full status to December 1929).
1929, 15 October: "a region around Khujand" passes to the Tajik SSR.
1930: "the Uzbek SSR capital was relocated from Samarkand to Tashkent".
1936, December: "That same year in December, it was renamed to the Uzbek Soviet Socialist Republic."
1991, 31 August: independence declared and the Uzbek SSR renamed the Republic of Uzbekistan, "three months before the Soviet Union's dissolution".

certainty.note: The pages list no districts for the Turkestan, Bukharan and Khorezm shares; the Karakalpak and Khujand lines are the other dossiers'.
Union-republic borders of 1936; the post-war Kazakh-Uzbek adjustments are undated.
